sub_answers.text: The International Cricket Council imposes a blanket ban on "corrupt conduct" by anyone it defines as a "participant" [d1328050s24p0]. The ICC shares anti-corruption jurisdiction with national cricket federations, with national federations responsible for domestic matches and the ICC having exclusive or priority jurisdiction over international matches [d1328050s24p0].

sub_answers.text: There exists an old and thriving Yoruba community in Ghana tracing back to more than three centuries of establishment [d19996678s27p0]. During the Gold Coast colonial period, Yoruba migrants had firmly entrenched themselves in the country's commerce and distribution systems and constituted a substantial percentage of merchants and traders in large markets [d19996678s27p0].

sub_answers.text: A ground described as having five turf wickets and a players' pavilion exists in Ghanaian cricket infrastructure reporting [d49520073s1p0]. Outside that ground there are three additional turf wickets, an astro turf wicket and four concrete practice wickets documented for practice use [d49520073s1p0]. The facility includes an indoor facility, a complex for women players, a gymnasium and a shuttle badminton court, indicating some multi-use amenities rather than extensive dedicated cricket practice nets or expanded clubhouse facilities [d49520073s1p0].

sub_answers.text: Post-independence Ghana developed constitutional protections and disability frameworks built on colonial legal and institutional structures, showing continuity from colonial-era institutions into modern governance frameworks [d60988680s3p0].
